decisionProcess.summary: The accessible route is a named meetings professional with explicit WIC hotel responsibility, supported by an operational association-management contact. The public evidence shows a room block and hotel selection already in place, but not the internal approval chain, contracting entity, TMC or future-event sourcing process.
decisionProcess.notes: Meetings sourcing is demonstrably distinct from ordinary transient travel in this opportunity because WIA publishes a dedicated event room block and meetings contact. Final contracting authority and whether Stringfellow Management Group signs or manages hotel agreements remain unknown.
unknowns: No documented evidence confirms voco Cancún Zona Hotelera as a WIA supplier, overflow hotel or shortlisted property.
Hotel-sourcing model, TMC usage, preferred-hotel policy and meetings-versus-transient procurement split are unknown.
The target hotel's official address, website, brand and detailed specifications remain unresolved in the supplied hotel context.
A second contact is relevant and verified, but neither contact is proven to hold final hotel-contract signature authority.
